title: The Power of Many: Multi-Agent Multimodal Models for Cultural Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image captioning performance of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on culturally diverse datasets (images from China, India, and Romania) by measuring the inclusion of culture-specific terms (Cultural Information metric), text-to-image alignment, completeness, and human-assessed caption correctness to assess and mitigate predominantly Western-centric perspectives.
